worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.summary: Raise a ring of roots under the target and lock on, draining its life in several waves and returning a share of each wave's damage to the user. Once locked, moving away does not break the drain; it ends when all waves are drawn or the target falls.
Each wave deals about %1$s special damage; it draws %2$s wave(s) in all, one every %3$s s.
The roots reach %1$s blocks (also the real range).
%1$s of each wave's damage is restored to the user.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.deepPour.on: Deep pour: two heavy waves, wider roots and a fiercer draw, but slower, longer cooldown and easier to interrupt.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.deepPour.off: Three light waves: more total healing and a faster rhythm for staying in the fight.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.growth.0: From level %1$s each wave rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.growth.1: From level %1$s each wave rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the waves to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.0: Strip a foe's life away from across the field
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.1: Pull a health line back when it is running low
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.use.2: Pin a high-value target under several waves
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.preference.d: On: two heavy waves, wider roots and a fiercer draw, but slower, longer cooldown and easier to interrupt. Off: three light waves with more total healing and a faster rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.gigadrain.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than drawing roots. Larger opens from further away.
Below this health ratio the user prefers giga drain as sustain; higher spends the long cooldown sooner.
Only at or beyond this distance does the user gain a ranged-opener bonus; lower prefers point-blank draws, higher prefers to open from outside.
On: only spend this move below the heal threshold, saving the long cooldown for sustain. Off: treat it as an ordinary ranged heavy even at full health.
Once the roots rise under the target they lock on: every later wave still lands on that target even if it moves away; only the target falling or leaving ends the drain early, with any remaining waves lost.
